dates.name: Utah Pride Festival & Celebration
dates.price: Free admission to festival; $30 for 21+ foam party (optional)
dates.desc: Vibrant two-day celebration of LGBTQIA+ community at Washington Square. Live performances, food vendors, community organizations, family-friendly activities. Plus new for 2026: evening foam party for ages 21+ with local DJs. Energetic, colorful, inclusive atmosphere.
dates.start: Sunday 12:00 PM - 7:00 PM (Pride Parade Saturday 10:00 AM start at Capitol)
dates.where: Washington Square — 451 State Street, Salt Lake City, UT 84111

dates.name: Park Silly Sunday Market — Free Artisan Fair & Live Music
dates.desc: Open-air eco-friendly artist market with ~200 vendors, handmade goods, local artisan finds. Live music starts at noon. Browse unique crafts, enjoy food, discover Utah's creative community. Relaxed, fun Sunday vibe.
dates.where: Lower Main Street, Park City, UT

dates.name: Back to the Future — The Musical
dates.desc: Electrifying Broadway musical based on the beloved film! High-energy performances, incredible special effects, beloved characters brought to life on stage. Since you gave Phantom of the Opera a perfect 5, this theatrical experience showcases exceptional production, storytelling, and entertainment value.
dates.start: 7:00 PM (matinees Sat 1:00 PM, Sun 1:00 PM & 6:30 PM)
dates.where: Eccles Theater — 131 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: The Kid LAROI — A Perfect World Tour
dates.desc: Rising music sensation The Kid LAROI performs hits from his album with opener Tommy Richman. High-energy concert with devoted fan base. Great for music lovers seeking contemporary pop-rap energy and crowd atmosphere.
dates.where: The Union Event Center — 465 S 400 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Park Silly Sunday Market — Weekly Sunday Artisan Fest
dates.desc: Weekly free market returns with 200+ vendors, handmade goods, art installations, and live music. Perfect for browsing unique finds, enjoying local coffee/food, and supporting Utah artists.
dates.where: Lower Main Street, Park City, UT

dates.name: Salt Lake Bees — Minor League Baseball vs Tacoma Rainiers
dates.price: $15 - $35/ticket (families can get 4 tickets for $40 on Tuesdays)
dates.desc: Fun minor league baseball games with great stadium experience, reasonable prices, and games throughout the week. Perfect casual summer date night. Ballpark atmosphere without major league crowds.
dates.start: Game times vary (typically 6:05 PM or 6:35 PM)
dates.where: The Ballpark at America First Square — South Jordan, UT (11 Ballpark Way, South Jordan, UT 84095)

dates.name: Utah Arts Festival — 50th Anniversary Celebration
dates.desc: Premier arts festival celebrating 50 years! 170+ visual artist booths, live performances (GZA, Yola, Shakey Graves, Rubblebucket), dancing, music stages, hands-on art workshops, kids art yard, Fear No Film festival. Cultural experience with world-class talent.
dates.where: Civic Center (Library Square, City & County Building/Washington Square) — 200 E 400 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Millcreek Canyon Wildflower Hike — Early Summer Blooms
dates.price: $0 (canyon access free; $3-$5 parking lot fee optional)
dates.desc: Scenic canyon hike at lower elevation showcasing early-season wildflower blooms (lupine, Indian paintbrush). Shaded trail, cool waters, stunning mountain views. Only 20 minutes from downtown. Perfect for your love of nature and exploration dates.
dates.start: Morning or early afternoon (8:00 AM - 1:00 PM)
dates.where: Millcreek Canyon (various trail access points) — Salt Lake City, UT (20 min from downtown)

dates.name: Park Silly Sunday Market — Final Artisan Market for 2-Week Window
dates.desc: Weekly favorite returns again! Browse 200+ artisan vendors, local crafts, handmade goods. Live music, food vendors, community energy. Great for discovering unique items and supporting local creators.
dates.where: Lower Main Street, Park City, UT

dates.name: Rockport Reservoir — Summer Alpine Lake Adventure
dates.desc: Your proven favorite! Crystal alpine waters in the Uinta Mountains perfect for June paddling. Kayak, paddleboard, or shoreline picnic with incredible mountain scenery. Early summer weather makes this ideal.
dates.where: Rockport State Park — Coalville, UT (1 hr north from SLC)

dates.name: Antelope Island State Park — Bison & Wildlife Loop Drive
dates.desc: Drive the stunning 7-mile scenic loop spotting bison herds, pronghorn, and bighorn sheep. Great Salt Lake views, sunset opportunities, peaceful wildlife watching. Your type of exploration date.
dates.where: Antelope Island State Park — 4528 W 1700 S, Syracuse, UT 84075

dates.name: Cecret Lake Hike — Albion Basin Wildflowers & Alpine Views
dates.desc: Stunning 2.5-mile hike through Albion Basin with peak wildflowers (lupine, columbine, Indian paintbrush) in June. Crystal alpine lake at 10,340 ft surrounded by peaks. Accessible and spectacular.
dates.where: Albion Basin/Cecret Lake Trail — Alta, UT (Little Cottonwood Canyon, 45 min from SLC)

dates.name: Mirror Lake Scenic Byway — 42-Mile Alpine Drive
dates.desc: Stunning 42-mile drive through Uinta Mountains at 10,715 feet. Crystal alpine lakes, wildflowers, towering peaks. Stop for picnicking, short walks, or fishing. One of your favorite exploration experiences.
dates.where: Mirror Lake Highway — State Route 150, Kamas to Wyoming border (1.5 hrs from SLC)

dates.name: Bear Lake — Turquoise Alpine Lake Paddle Adventure
dates.desc: Pristine alpine lake with stunning turquoise water. Peaceful paddling, beautiful mountain scenery, summer weather ideal. Multiple access points and sunset paddling opportunities.
dates.where: Bear Lake State Park — Garden City, UT (1.5 hrs north)

dates.name: Dinner at Le Depot — Park City Award-Winning French Cuisine
dates.desc: Salt Lake Magazine's 2026 Best Fine Dining winner! Elegant French-inspired restaurant with sophisticated seasonal menus. Beautiful ambiance, expert service, and refined cuisine. Perfect for special occasions.
dates.where: Le Depot — Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Dinner at Handle — Park City Chef-Driven Small Plates
dates.desc: Intimate restaurant with celebrated seasonal small plates. Fresh fish, heritage meats, creative vegetables. Excellent wine list, sophisticated atmosphere. Cozy and romantic.
dates.where: Handle — Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Dinner at Log Haven — Millcreek Canyon Mountain Fine Dining
dates.desc: Scenic mountain setting four miles up Millcreek Canyon. Southwestern-influenced seasonal menu, beautiful views, excellent service. Romantic escape just minutes from downtown.
dates.where: Log Haven — Millcreek Canyon, Salt Lake City, UT

dates.name: Dinner at Arlo — Salt Lake City Award-Winning Contemporary
dates.desc: Chef Milo Carrier's celebrated seasonal American cuisine. James Beard semifinalist restaurant with innovative cooking and refined plating. Modern, sophisticated atmosphere with great wine pairings.
dates.where: Arlo — Downtown Salt Lake City, UT

dates.name: Local Brewery & Artisan Food Tour — Downtown SLC Scene
dates.desc: Explore Salt Lake's vibrant craft brewery and food scene. Sample local artisan foods, creative small bites, and craft beer pairings. Great conversation and discovery experience.
dates.where: Various breweries & restaurants — Downtown Salt Lake City

dates.name: Broadway Theater — Eccles Theater World-Class Productions
dates.desc: Since you loved Phantom of the Opera (5 stars), experience the Eccles' rotating schedule of high-caliber musicals and theater productions. Check the calendar for additional June performances beyond Back to the Future.
dates.where: Eccles Theater — 131 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Utah Symphony — Classical & Summer Concert Series
dates.desc: World-class orchestra performing classical masterworks and summer concert series. Romantic, sophisticated, culturally enriching. Check summer schedule for outdoor performances.
dates.where: Abravanel Hall — 123 W South Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Natural History Museum of Utah — Fossils & Discovery
dates.desc: 60,000+ fossils, interactive exhibits, stunning valley views. Educational and fascinating for exploration together. Summer exhibits rotate. Pair with nearby Red Butte Garden.
dates.where: Natural History Museum of Utah — 301 S 1300 E, Salt Lake City, UT 84112

dates.name: Salt Lake Arts District Gallery Walk — Local Artists & Installations
dates.desc: Explore vibrant downtown arts district with local galleries, contemporary installations, rotating exhibits. Grab coffee, discuss art, discover new favorites. First Friday features special evening events.
dates.where: Salt Lake City Arts District — Downtown SLC (Main, 200 S, 300 S area)

dates.name: Red Butte Garden — Summer Botanical Beauty & Pathways
dates.desc: Utah's premier botanical garden with summer bloom, peaceful pathways, scenic valley views. Perfect romantic stroll. June features peak wildflower blooms. Combine with Natural History Museum nearby.
dates.where: Red Butte Garden — 300 Wakara Way, Salt Lake City, UT 84108

dates.name: Horseback Riding at Sundance — Summer Mountain Trail Rides
dates.desc: Guided horseback rides through scenic Sundance mountain trails with June wildflowers and alpine overlooks. Beginner-friendly with experienced guides. Peaceful, romantic experience.
dates.where: Sundance Resort — 8841 Alpine Loop Rd, Sundance, UT 84604

dates.name: TopGolf Vineyard — Golf Games & Competition
dates.desc: Private bay with automatic scoring, full bar, great food. Zero golf skill required—just fun, friendly competition, and laughs. Relaxed, upbeat date night.
dates.where: TopGolf — 484 N Entertainment Way, Vineyard, UT

dates.name: Escape Room Challenge — Puzzle & Teamwork Adventure
dates.desc: 60-minute immersive puzzle experience with themed rooms. Solve puzzles together, race the clock, enjoy teamwork. Great for competitive couples seeking collaboration.
dates.where: Getout Games — 202 W 400 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Mountain Biking — Park City Scenic Trail Network
dates.desc: Scenic mountain biking through Park City's extensive trail network. Multiple difficulty levels, beautiful views, great exercise. Summer weather perfect for riding.
dates.where: Park City Mountain Resort — Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Deer Valley Summer Activities — Hiking & Scenic Chairlifts
dates.desc: Lift-served mountain activities in summer. Scenic chairlift rides, easy to moderate hiking trails with wildflowers, alpine views. Perfect for active but relaxed date.
dates.where: Deer Valley Resort — Park City, UT

dates.name: Craft Lake City — Local Artisan Marketplace & Live Music
dates.desc: Browse and support local Utah artists and makers. Handmade goods, unique finds, live music, food vendors. Vibrant creative energy and cultural experience.
dates.where: Various locations throughout Salt Lake City

dates.name: Snowbird Aerial Tram — Summit Views & Mountain Dining
dates.desc: Scenic 2,000-foot aerial tram to Hidden Peak (11,000 ft) with 360° alpine views. Perfect for photos, sunset viewing, or summit dinner. Accessible and spectacular.
dates.where: Snowbird Resort — Little Cottonwood Canyon, UT (45 min from SLC)

dates.name: Hot Air Balloon Sunrise Flight — Magical Aerial Experience
dates.desc: Magical sunrise hot air balloon flight over Utah landscapes. Float peacefully with panoramic views. Romantic, unforgettable, bucket-list experience.
dates.where: Various launch sites near Salt Lake City (coordinated pickup)

dates.name: Outdoor Summer Concert Series — Free Live Music Under Stars
dates.desc: Free outdoor concerts throughout Salt Lake and Park City in summer. Bring a picnic, blanket, and enjoy live music under the stars. Romantic and budget-friendly.
dates.where: Various parks — SLC (Sugarhouse, Liberty, etc.) and Park City parks

dates.name: Live Comedy Night — Local Comedy Clubs & Venues
dates.desc: Live stand-up comedy at local venues. Great laughs, casual atmosphere, fun evening. Perfect for low-pressure fun and connection.
dates.where: The Wiseguys Comedy Club & venues — Downtown SLC
